cohort: 100 neonates (50 singleton and 50 multiples) born in Fatemieh Hospital of Hamadan, Iran in 2015
finding: Multiple pregnancies were associated with lower gestational age and birth weight, increased rates of neonatal complications and interventions, and a higher frequency of cesarean section and preterm delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was lower in multiple births than singleton births.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in multiple births than singleton births.
